remaining_pre_attempt_path: validate() calls _validate_base and then _successor_context; no retained-completion overlay is installed.
admission.admit() calls module.materialized_preflight(ctx) after its retained replay; materialized_preflight invokes frozen _verified_completed_groups before any run_group call.
execute() repeats materialized_preflight, then _runtime_lease and frozen run_group. The same completed-set mismatch would fail again under the frozen C4 disk guard if admission were bypassed.

frozen run_group checks _matrix_elapsed_wall, source snapshot, tools, reservation, _assert_fresh, and only then creates the attempt directory. The retained overlay must not suppress any of these checks.

runtime_registration_related_blocker.summary: The successor also needs the six historical contract contexts registered for frozen _matrix_elapsed_wall; this review does not relabel that prior finding.

static_no_additional_mismatch_found: The current successor keeps its current CodeQL source_inputs, tool bindings, qualifications, group identity, source projection limit, aggregate working cap, and per-attempt lease fields; these remain separately guarded and are not evidence of the missing retained overlay.
The overlay must be installed on the runtime successor object used by _runtime_lease/run_group, while preserving the frozen base object and its 55/2 packet byte-for-byte.

candidate_preflight.calculation: 55 inherited retained completions + 0 current-CodeQL rows = 55 verified; 84 known plan groups - 55 = 29 remaining

finding.mechanism: The frozen _verified_completed_groups seeds from successor.resource_recovery.retained_completed and then accepts current ledger rows only when their contract_sha256 equals the current successor bytes_sha256. The 27 completed C4-tail rows retain the old C4 hash, so they are neither in the inherited 55 map nor eligible for the current-contract scan.
finding.why_the_local_context_map_does_not_fix_i: The _historical_replay_contexts map is used by _replay_completed for checker inputs, but _verified_completed_groups reads successor.resource_recovery, not ctx["_historical_replay_contexts"]. Deriving contexts alone therefore cannot make the frozen capacity/remaining-group check see the 27 C4 completions.

Change any original row contract/source/plan identity or context binding: the frozen checker/overlay validator must reject it rather than substitute the successor CodeQL identity.
Drop any of the six noncompleted records or change their typed status: validation must fail closed; they must remain failures/recorder-errors and remain part of the historical context proof.
Leave the C4 base packet at exactly 55 retained completions and two retained failures: mutating that packet to 82/6 is an invalid shortcut.
overlay_requirements: Install all 82 verified completed records in the successor runtime retained_completed map; records must retain each original row, ledger-line hash, original context contract hash, original plan commit, and attempt number.

Install all six verified noncompleted records in the successor runtime retained_failures map with their original failed/recorder-error status and contract/source/plan identity; do not promote a failure to completion.

Merge normalized C1/C2/C3/base/Joern03/Joern04 contexts into the runtime successor resource_recovery.contexts for frozen registration, while preserving the historical base packet as a separate immutable value.
Run frozen _verified_completed_groups on the corrected successor and require 82 before any fresh CodeQL attempt; materialized_preflight must then report remaining_group_count=2.
After a successful fresh CodeQL tail, the expected verified count becomes 83 and the reviewed post-success denominator remains 89 ledger rows, 83 selected groups, 87 partitions, and 4144 rows.

derived_historical_contexts.behavior: Derives normalized C1/C2/C3/base/Joern03/Joern04 contexts in a local map; current code does not install that map into successor.resource_recovery.contexts.

frozen_c4_validator.interpretation: This is the immutable C4 historical packet and must remain unchanged; it is not an 88-row successor verification result.
